papers.action: NOT FETCHED - www.aanda.org returns HTTP 403 to every automated route tried (curl with browser UA/Referer on the /articles/aa/pdf/2026/06/aa58655-25.pdf path and all 8 issue-number variants; WebFetch on the full_html and ref pages). papers.prompt_sections: unread - expected: their Table of per-burst DTW lags (our burst is in the 50-single-pulse GBM sample), plus their asymmetric-pulse caveat section; ALL prompt, nothing to defer
papers.burst_content: unread. Abstract (ADS, verbatim gist): constrained DTW applied to 50 single-pulse Fermi/GBM GRBs, compared with Gaussian peak-time fitting and MCCF; lags agree within 3 sigma; for evidently asymmetric pulses a symmetric-Gaussian full-pulse fit biases the inferred lag while peak-focused Gaussian fitting agrees with DTW/MCCF; simulations recover input lags.

Its asymmetric-pulse warning bears directly on Shao+2017's Gaussian-based Delta-t_HR for this burst (Lu+2018's FRED gives r=2.62 vs d=14.53, i.e. strongly asymmetric).
